common:
Create a premium HAVENLINE game-resource 360-degree concept turnaround sheet, matching the supplied Havenline art boards precisely in visual language: polished stylized 3D, chunky rounded forms, broad sculpted details, warm caramel wood, restrained cool-metal highlights, readable game silhouettes, handcrafted inviting winter-survival aesthetic. The reference images are STYLE references, not edit targets. Do not copy their buildings, layout, UI or tiny text.
Landscape high-resolution sheet, ideally 3072x2048. Uniform dark navy studio background. Elegant clear small heading at top and eight equally sized view panels arranged exactly FOUR columns by TWO rows. Same SINGLE asset rotated in place about the vertical axis, same physical geometry and color/material pattern in EVERY panel. Camera elevation 15 degrees above horizontal, orthographic-like product rendering. Consistent subject scale, fixed soft neutral studio light, generous margins, fully visible objects. Exact clockwise yaw order: top row FRONT 0°, FRONT RIGHT 45°, RIGHT 90°, REAR RIGHT 135°; bottom row REAR 180°, REAR LEFT 225°, LEFT 270°, FRONT LEFT 315°. Front and rear must be genuinely opposite surfaces; right and left are true narrow end/profile views, not repeated three-quarter views. Make stable distinctive landmarks and physically coherent occlusions. Each view gets only its exact readable name below. No perspective diagram arrows, no environment, no ground tile, no props, no anatomy, no hands, no logos/watermarks. Small footer reads "360° CONCEPT TURNAROUND".

specs.title: WOOD
specs.body: One compact pickup bundle of exactly THREE short substantial cut logs, two on bottom and one centered above, all parallel to the world horizontal X axis. Warm golden cut ends with broad simple concentric growth rings, medium caramel brown bark with stylized grooves; gently chunky forms. One tan rope binding around the bundle at its exact middle with a small knot only on its FRONT long side. No pallet, no snow, no metal bands, no branch twigs, no plank stack. At FRONT the long sides are broad; RIGHT is a direct view of the three circular cut ends in a triangle; REAR shows the opposite long sides and no knot; LEFT shows the opposite cut ends. Both log ends always sawn flat. Preserve same log lengths/count/shape at every angle.

specs.title: STONE
specs.body: One individual thick chunky natural quarried rock as the pickup unit, warm neutral grey granite/taupe with large softly beveled facets and a few broad carved cracks, much thicker and more rounded than slate. Approximate irregular wedge shape 1.3 long x1.0 deep x0.8 tall; highest rounded peak at rear-left, low sloping shoulder at front-right, a distinctive small shallow notch on FRONT surface near right edge. NO crystals, no metallic flakes, no snow, no loose gravel pile, no base. Its irregular shape and notch must rotate coherently and stay the same across all eight views.

specs.title: SLATE
specs.body: One individual flat thick slate slab pickup, a broad irregular rectangular plate 1.6 long x1.0 deep x0.26 tall. Deep desaturated blue-grey stone with three to four clear horizontal stratified layers along the edges. Softly bevel irregular outline but retain unmistakable flat split-slate structure; one missing small corner on the FRONT-RIGHT side and one broad pale gray natural seam along upper face toward rear-left. No glossy metal, no crystals, no tile grout, no pile, no snow, no base. All cracks, layers and chipped corner remain fixed on the slab as it turns. FRONT is broad edge, RIGHT narrow end edge, REAR opposite broad edge, LEFT opposite narrow edge.
